next.reason: 1985: the released record is no longer available unless the file is in a SAME RECORD AREA clause, then available as a record of the other files in it. §2023:14.9.35.4 GR6 states the same ('is no longer available in the record area unless file-name-1 or the file-name associated with record-name-1 is specified in a SAME RECORD AREA clause'); file-name-1 belongs to the new FILE phrase.
